A1.name: Unit of retrieval
A1.question: What the search returns as a single result.

A2.name: Segmentation
A2.question: By what rule a document is cut into units.

A3.name: Unit enrichment
A3.question: What is added to a unit beyond its own text.

A4.name: Index topology
A4.question: How units are connected to one another inside the store.

A5.name: Representation model
A5.question: In what form a unit is compared against the query.

A6.name: Temporality
A6.question: How the store accounts for time.

A7.name: Modality
A7.question: What kind of data is stored.

A8.name: Origin of index structure
A8.question: Where the connections between units came from.

B1.name: Query transformation
B1.question: What happens to the query before the index is consulted.

B2.name: Routing
B2.question: How the processing path for a query is chosen.

C1.name: Search operator
C1.question: By what operation candidates are taken from the index.

C2.name: Traversal control
C2.question: How many times the system consults the index, and who decides.

C3.name: Source fusion
C3.question: How results from several searches are combined.

D1.name: Reranking
D1.question: How retrieved candidates are ordered anew.

D2.name: Selection and compression
D2.question: How what was found is reduced to what fits the model window.

D3.name: Arrangement
D3.question: In what order the selected material is given to the model.

E2.name: Groundedness control
E2.question: How the answer's support in the retrieved material is checked.

E3.name: Attribution
E3.question: What a citation in the answer points to.

E4.name: Refusal policy
E4.question: Under what conditions the system declines to answer.

E5.name: Coupling of generation to retrieval
E5.question: Whether generated text influences further search.

F1.name: Write-back
F1.question: Whether the system stores the result of its work for future queries.

F2.name: Conflict resolution
F2.question: What happens when stored material contradicts stored material.

F3.name: Forgetting
F3.question: How stored material stops being taken into account.

G1.name: Privacy
G1.question: What regime of data handling is provided.

G3.name: Trainability of components
G3.question: Which parts of the system are trained and which are taken ready-made.

A1.proposition: Proposition, that is a single self-contained statement

A2.late_chunking: Late, after encoding the whole document

A4.hypergraph: Hypergraph, where an edge joins more than two nodes

A6.bitemporal: Bitemporal: event time and record time

B1.hyde: Hypothetical answer in place of the query
B1.step_back: Step back to a more general question

B2.llm_router: Choice made by a language model

C2.agentic_open_loop: Open loop driven by the model

D1.cross_encoder: Joint encoder of query and candidate

E2.decoding_trigger: Search invoked on a sign of uncertainty

E5.generation_seeds: Generated text sets the next query
E5.mutual_loop: Mutual loop of search and generation
